SEO/GEO audit fixes: canonical, og:url, schema, meta lengths, theme-color, manifest, /vs FAQ

From the forensic SEO+GEO audit (25 verified findings, 2-of-3 lens-gated):
- A1 (high): /acknowledgements now self-canonicalizes (was inheriting the homepage canonical).
- C2 (high): og:url now emitted site-wide + per page (was absent).
- C1/C3/D3/E5: /vs/[slug] pages gain BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD, a visible
  3-question FAQ (thicker content), and per-page OpenGraph/Twitter.
- C4/C5: home + /compare meta descriptions trimmed to ~160c, /compare title to <60c.
- D1: theme-color viewport (dark/light). D2: web app manifest.
- A2/C8: sitemap homepage loc no longer trailing-slash-mismatched with the canonical.
- E6: Organization sameAs (GitHub, Telegram) for entity disambiguation.

Verified live: canonical /acknowledgements, og:url, theme-color x2, manifest 200,
/vs BreadcrumbList+FAQPage, compare title 62c, home desc 161c.
